ARMOR RATING vs. WEAPON CALIBER (AP) MATRIX

Every weapon has an Armor Penetration (AP / Caliber) rating and every hull has an Armor Rating (with +25% Bow Armor on the front 90° arc and −25% Stern Armor on the rear engine arc). Small-caliber lasers deflect off heavy capital plating, while massive un-jacketed spinal rail/gauss slugs Overpenetrate (65% damage) if fired at paper-thin scouts (AP ≥ 3.5 × TargetArmor) unless equipped with Fragmentation/HE nodes.
